asked.item: cleanTranscript=true on REST still leaves timestamps
Is the param named differently in REST?

verdict.reason: The Get Source page says cleanTranscript is not a REST parameter, explains the n8n local option, and says to remove timestamps in your own workflow for REST.

steps.text: cleanTranscript is not a REST query parameter or an MCP tool argument, so don't send it to this endpoint expecting it to change the response.
The n8n Blotato node's Source > Get operation has a local Clean Transcript option, enabled by default, that processes the returned content after the API request.
For REST, retrieve the completed content first, then remove transcript timestamps in your agent or workflow.
